notes.title: OGORA Joins Steam Next Fest + Our First Major Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45241720/427e324ed3e555b815468131aa26e03d54bff1c9.png[/img]

[b]Good morning from across the globe![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that Ogora will be a part of Steam Next Fest! This means you’ll now be able to experience the newly updated demo [b]V0.8.0[/b], try out our latest features, and provide feedback that will help shape the game before launch.

But that’s not all—we’ve been hard at work making Ogora even better!

[b]Major Updates[/b]

💖 [b]A New Life System[/b]

Gone are the days of single-run survival! We’ve introduced a brand-new life system, giving you more opportunities to push forward and strategize your way through intense battles. Be careful though, as you might find yourself a little less healthy than you’re used to! This really let us create a more meaningful early game, and reward optimal play going into later acts!

📰 [b]All-New Cards & Shops[/b]

We’ve added a whole new set of powerful cards to expand your deck-building choices. Plus, revamped shops now offer more strategic options, allowing you to plan your build like never before. Let us know if there’s any you love (or hate)!

💎 [b]Never-Before-Seen Trinkets[/b]

Discover brand-new trinkets with unique effects that can completely change the way you approach each run. These mysterious artifacts hold immense power—will you harness them wisely? I know I haven’t…

👾 [b]New Enemies[/b]

Prepare for fresh challenges! We've added new enemies to test your skills and force you to adapt your strategies in unexpected ways.

📖 [b]Overhauled Events[/b]

Every event in Ogora has been reworked and refined to be more engaging and immersive. We really wanted to focus on creating more fun and interesting decisions. Also, your friends might offer you some special options while you’re there!

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

Steam Next Fest begins Feb 25th, we can’t wait for you to try the latest version of Ogora and hear your thoughts!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/NHdzQNVE7M]Discord[/url] and get ready to journey through Ogora!

🎮 [b]Add Ogora to your [url=steam://advertise/3262090]Steam wishlist[/url] now![/b]

— The Ogora Dev Team

notes.title: OGORA: Prologue Update 0.7.5
notes.content:
[b]GOOD MORNING[/b]🌛 and welcome to the first patch notes of the Ogora Prologue!

NEW GAMEPLAY CONTENT 🎮 

[list]
[*] Added a mini tutorial for a player's first run. Everybody will receive this tutorial once even if you have previously done a run, however it will not show up again after defeating the first enemy.
[*] Stamina can now be gained as a battle reward if no bomb is dropped
[*] All bomb sprites and explosion radiuses updated
[*] Bomb logic now updates dynamically depending on bombed position verse player position (e.g. bombing a path to the left of your position will bomb outwards towards the left)
[*] Added a slight damage roll to some enemies
[/list]

BUG FIXING 🐛 & QOL 😇 

[list]
[*] Fixed Paper Clip and Stamp relics not working as intended in certain circumstances
[*] Trinkets such as Fan and Schematics now correctly trigger in scenarios where a card's cost is changed when played (looking at you Air Slash 👀)
[*] Fixed bug where HP would remain when a battle is won > main menu > continued at the beginning of the battle with the HP pre-continue
[*] Purchasing Eviolite in the shop will now randomly upgrade all the current common cards in the shop
[*] Fixed po and terry tooltip not showing correct attack multiplier
[*] Sanguine Blade will now heal for the correct amount even if the enemy dies
[*] Fixed some shop pricings not updating properly when gold would be gained/lost mid shop
[/list]

VISUAL AND AUDIO UPDATES✨ 

[list]
[*] Updated many in battle hit text effects, it should be much easier now to tell how much damage is being dealt to both enemies and the player
[*] Added more visual triggers to when Statuses are applied or triggered
[*] Added a little life to enemy intents when triggering
[*] Updated Relic trigger animations
[*] Added sfx for various things such as adding a card to hand mid battle, obtaining a bomb, obtaining a trinket and more
[*] It is now slightly more clear when the Summon boss is no longer dormant
[*] Added some pizzazz to the enemy intent tooltip
[*] Entering a new Act will now show a title card for that act
[*] Cards with the Learn keyword (create a spell) now show a spell tool tip when hovering that card
[*] Spruced up the Shop so it's easier to understand what is what and pricing of things
[*] Spiced up the card removal screen + animation
[*] Cards will now move around a little more smoothly when entering a new home (deck)
[*] Livened up the rewards screen after a victory
[*] Added mini voices to all the partners
[/list]

We hope you all have a great holiday season! 🎄 We are continuously working on updating the game leading into Steam Next Fest in Feb. Expect to see more updates in the coming weeks!
